metrics.label: Forecast residual load
metrics.limitations: Consumption forecast minus wind and solar forecasts. Not net imports, a system deficit, procurement volume or a price prediction.

metrics.label: Consumption forecast change over one hour
metrics.limitations: Latest minus an observed collection one hour earlier (30-minute tolerance). Not necessarily a provider model-run revision.

metrics.label: Consumption error
metrics.limitations: Actual minus forecast collected approximately 24 hours earlier (30-minute tolerance). Not an official day-ahead forecast or a retailer imbalance.
